subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or keep waiting for another current-main fix path before this issue can close?
rationale: The issue is paired with an open same-author closing PR, but the branch is conflicting and proof-gated while current main has only partial active-run recovery.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while using the current chat lifecycle, session active-run, and protocol package surfaces.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original author can update the linked PR and add redacted live Dashboard tab-switch/reconnect evidence before another review.

options.title: Wait for a different fix path
options.body: Keep this issue open until another proof-positive PR supersedes the stale linked branch and closes the exact busy-state recovery gap.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while using the current chat lifecycle, session active-run, and protocol package surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main chat lifecycle and active-run recovery code is now in the refactored surface attributed to steipete's recent commit.
